body:
I'm running into a similar issue, Vue has the ability to compile to web components or custom elements, so on the face of it, this should work for me.  However because the widgets needs to be wrapped within the <ais-instant-search> component then I can't separate the widgets I need out to use in my environment as I like.

Now, my use case is quite unique because I'm working to create widgets that work in a low code platform so the widgets need to work independently.
